senses.gloss: f., with suffix גִּתּ־, גִּיתּ־ (contr. of גֶּנֶת) a marked-off space.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 15:7">Tosef. Ohol. XV, 7</cite> ‘the court of a burying place’ <he>זו הגת … לתוכה</he> (R. S. to Ohol. XV, 8, ed. Zuck. <he>לתוכו</he>, Var. <cite ref="C00848"><he>גל</he></cite>) is the marked space into which the caverns open.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 4:2">Par. IV, 2</cite> <he>שרפה חוץ מגִּתָּהּ</he> if he burnt the cow outside of the place selected for the purpose; <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 14:1">Zeb. XIV, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 3:9">Tosef. Par. III, 9</cite> sq.—Pl. <he>גִּתּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="C01432"><he>גִּיתּ׳</he></cite>. Par. l. c.
